title: Thinkspace Travel — complete demo walkthrough
scope: Full Travel Desk workflow: access, list, create form toggle, validation, draft with legs/notes, submit, staff approve (expense seed), reject, cancel lifecycle, invalid cancel error, hub navigation, cleanup (sections A–G).
prerequisites: E2E user should be staff for Approve/Reject steps (P-TR08, P-TR09, P-TR16)
Optional: E2E_DEMO_PAUSE_MS (default 1200) for headed video pacing

crudSummary.Create: New request form → Save draft → POST travel/requests/
crudSummary.Read: List on load (GET travel/requests/), row metadata, legs, status badges
crudSummary.Update: Submit, Approve, Reject, Cancel → POST travel/requests/:id/ { action }
crudSummary.Delete: No delete UI — demo cleanup cancels non-terminal rows via API

steps.title: Open Travel Desk
steps.uiLocation: TravelHubPage — Travel Desk heading, New request, list section
steps.functionality: Loads the Travel hub. On mount the page fetches all travel requests for the user (staff sees all; others see own). Shows Thinkspace label, title, subtitle, and action buttons.

steps.title: List or empty state
steps.userAction: Observe request cards or 'No travel requests yet.' placeholder
steps.uiLocation: TravelHubPage — article rows or empty message
steps.functionality: Each row is an article with title, destination · dates · status, optional leg summary (From → To), and contextual action buttons. Empty tenant shows muted placeholder text.

steps.title: Open create form
steps.functionality: Toggles inline grid form with Title, Destination, Start/End date, From/To leg, Notes, and Save draft. Button label switches to Close while form is open.

steps.title: Required-field guard
steps.userAction: Click Save draft with empty required fields
steps.functionality: Client-side guard: missing title, destination, or dates prevents submit handler from calling API. Form stays open; no new row appears.

steps.title: Save draft with trip leg and notes
steps.uiLocation: Create form — Title, Destination, dates, From/To leg, Notes
steps.functionality: Creates TravelRequest in Draft status. Optional legs array sent when From or To filled (mode Flight, travel_date = start_date). Form closes and list refreshes; new row shows leg line.

steps.title: Verify list row metadata
steps.userAction: Confirm destination, date range, Draft status, and leg on the new row
steps.uiLocation: Request article — subtitle and leg line
steps.functionality: Read-only display of persisted trip: destination · start → end · status, plus joined leg strings.

steps.title: Submit draft for approval
steps.functionality: Transitions Draft → Submitted. Submit button hidden afterward. Requester can still Cancel while not terminal.

steps.title: Staff approve submitted request
steps.functionality: Staff-only buttons when status is Submitted. Approve → Approved; backend seeds draft Expense claim linked to trip and notifies requester. Approve/Reject buttons removed.

steps.title: Create second request (for reject path)
steps.userAction: New request → fill required fields → Save draft
steps.functionality: Second independent travel request in Draft to demonstrate reject workflow without affecting the approved record.

steps.title: Submit second request
steps.functionality: Same submit transition on a separate record for the reject demonstration.

steps.title: Staff reject submitted request
steps.functionality: Staff rejects Submitted request → Rejected (terminal for approve/reject). Requester notified via backend.

steps.title: Invalid cancel on Rejected request
steps.userAction: Click Cancel on Rejected row → observe error alert
steps.functionality: UI still shows Cancel on Rejected, but API workflow blocks Rejected → Cancelled. Error alert displays server message; status stays Rejected.

steps.title: Abandon create form
steps.userAction: New request → type title → Close without saving
steps.functionality: Closing form discards in-progress input; no API call, no new list row.

steps.title: Create third request to cancel
steps.functionality: Third record kept in Draft for cancel-from-draft demonstration.

steps.title: Cancel draft request
steps.functionality: Draft → Cancelled. Cancel button hidden on terminal Cancelled status.

steps.title: Navigate back to Thinkspace hub
steps.functionality: Returns to /thinkspace module dial / hub landing.

steps.title: Return to Travel Desk
steps.userAction: Navigate to /thinkspace/travel again — final list state
steps.uiLocation: TravelHubPage — full list with Approved, Rejected, Cancelled rows
steps.functionality: Re-enter module; list shows all demo records with final statuses for video closing shot.

excludedFromTravelDemo.Booked / Completed status: No UI or API action exposed yet
excludedFromTravelDemo.Guest / unauthenticated access: Covered in N-TR01 spec, not in headed demo
excludedFromTravelDemo.Non-staff Approve/Reject: Requires second user — N-TR06 manual only
